init._comment: BBD listening check (spec 2026-07-27 flux-bbd-delay). Not a byte gate -- this project does not add checksum gates for new audio paths. It exists so the four claims of the design are audible in one file: the clock bends pitch, STAGES is five octaves of brightness, DRIVE dirties every repeat, and the lane turns the delay into a vibrato.

events._comment: 1) The clock bends pitch. No crossfade in the physical device and none here: a division change slides.
2) STAGES: five octaves of brightness at a fixed delay time, and a drift in time and pitch on the way.
3) DRIVE inside the loop, with feedback high: harmonics accumulate over the repeats and tip into thick self-oscillation.
4) The lane on FLUX TIME: the whole historical chorus/vibrato range lives in the bottom tenth of this control.
